Native FPCR inference and wild-bootstrap manuscript reporting

etr_native_inference_reporting.Rd

Python-free functions construct explicit scientific reporting strings from already computed results. They never fit a model, resample, calibrate a confidence band, or select hyperparameters.

Usage

etr_fpca_wild_bootstrap_projection_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_regression_future_prediction_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_regression_uncertainty_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_regression_slope_band_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_nested_regression_cv_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_wild_bootstrap_family_test_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_wild_bootstrap_monte_carlo_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_wild_bootstrap_simultaneous_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_regression_cv_reporting_text(result, rule = "minimum", digits = 3L)
etr_fpca_component_envelope_reporting_text(result, digits = 2L)
etr_fpca_wild_bootstrap_truncation_reporting_text(result, digits = 3L)

Arguments

result

An explicit named R list containing the scientifically defined results and source-aligned fields needed by the selected reporting method. Objects must already have been computed. Native fitted results supply replicate and target counts through their retained arrays. Explicit reporting lists may supply those counts directly.

digits

Nonnegative integer decimal precision for the output.

rule

Explicit minimum or one-standard-error selection rule for FPCA regression CV reporting.

Value

A character scalar containing descriptive manuscript wording. The wording does not by itself establish an estimator's validity or interval coverage.

Details

The source reference is the published eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 reporting.py at commit c1cd95ad718327550f7e55393ff38582872f7a94. The R accepted-input domain is intentionally narrower than the Python dataclass contract. A Python 1.2 direct-text oracle is available as an opt-in test, but full input type, return semantics and independent reviewer certification remain pending. In particular, future-outcome prediction intervals, conditional-mean uncertainty, pointwise slope envelopes, and observed-grid simultaneous inference remain distinct estimands.
